# MCP tools

Each contract served on MCP is one tool, named by its tag, as `tools/list` shows it over `/mcp` and over stdio from `myr mcp`. A stream has no tool, and no tool takes a write-only value, which must never pass through an agent's transcript. A tool's input is the contract's payload and its output is the contract's success. A refusal comes back as the tool's error result: the refusal as JSON, `_tag` and all (see [refusals.md](refusals.md)).

The hints come from each contract's own annotations. No tool reaches anything outside the platform, so `openWorldHint` is always false.

## listProjects

List every project on the platform, with its posture and how many asks it has open.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `true` |

### Input

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "type": "object"
}
```

### Output

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "projects": {
      "items": {
        "additionalProperties": true,
        "properties": {
          "landedAt": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "openAsks": {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "posture": {
            "enum": [
              "open",
              "openWithSealedEvidence",
              "openOnSchedule",
              "openCore",
              "sourceAvailable"
            ],
            "type": "string"
          },
          "project": {
            "allOf": [
              {
                "not": {
                  "enum": [
                    "assets",
                    "auth",
                    "icons",
                    "people",
                    "releases",
                    "rpc",
                    "today"
                  ]
                }
              }
            ],
            "pattern": "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "openAsks",
          "posture",
          "project"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "projects"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## frontPage

List the open asks across every project, each saying whether the caller may take it; optionally of one kind, or held for newcomers or people.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `true` |

```json

  "additionalProperties": true,
```

## verdict

Show the verdict on an answer to an ask, for its latest head or the one named; held-back checks show one bit per area.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `true` |

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "ask": {
      "allOf": [
        {
          "not": {
            "enum": [
              "me",
              "layer",
              "open",
              "flag"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "head": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{40}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "project": {
      "allOf": [
        {
          "not": {
            "enum": [
              "assets",
              "auth",
              "icons",
              "people",
              "releases",
              "rpc",
              "today"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ask",
    "project"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## landing

| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `true` |

## credits

Count a person's credits by project, area and role; never a score.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |

## claim

Claim an ask: an exclusive, expiring right to answer it, with a fork to push to; claiming it again returns the same claim.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `false` |

### Input

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "ask": {
      "allOf": [
        {
          "not": {
            "enum": [
              "me",
              "layer",
              "open",
              "flag"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "project": {
      "allOf": [
        {
          "not": {
            "enum": [
              "assets",
              "auth",
              "icons",
              "people",
              "releases",
              "rpc",
              "today"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ask",
    "project"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## submitAnswer

## finish

Finish a passing answer with a decider's own commits on top; they are checked again, and credited with Finished-by when it lands. Asks a person first.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `false` |

## land

Land a decider's own change from their working fork, after the same checks an answer passes. Asks a person first.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `false` |

## fork

Make the caller's working fork of a project, or return it if it exists.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `false` |

### Input

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "project": {
      "allOf": [
        {
          "not": {
            "enum": [
              "assets",
              "auth",
              "icons",
              "people",
              "releases",
              "rpc",
              "today"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "project"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### Output

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "fork": {
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "remote": {
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "fork",
    "remote"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## vouch

Vouch for a person, or denounce them, by landing a line in the project's vouch file. Asks a person first.

| Hint | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` |
| `idempotentHint` | `false` |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` |
| `readOnlyHint` | `false` |

### Input

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "handle": {
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "note": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "project": {
      "allOf": [
        {
          "not": {
            "enum": [
              "assets",
              "auth",
              "icons",
              "people",
              "releases",
              "rpc",
              "today"
            ]
          }
        }
      ],
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "verdict": {
      "enum": [
        "vouch",
        "denounce"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "handle",
    "project",
    "verdict"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

### Output

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": true,
  "properties": {
    "landed": {
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{40}$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "landed"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```
